content: This content is part of the World Health Organization's 2014 efforts to inform the development process of the Consolidated Guidelines on HIV prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and care for key populations. In closing, I would like to sincerely thank you for your time and for your willingness to share your personal experiences, views, and feelings. Before we conclude, is there anything else you would like to add at this time? If you have any questions or would like to provide feedback, feel free to contact the MSMGF staff. You may already have their contact details from a previous email, but if it would be helpful, I can repeat this information for your convenience. Thank you once again for your time today. Would now be a good time to end the call?
